question: What is the only sport specifically designed to be played by participants of both genders simultaneously?
solution:
The correct answer is __** Korfball.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Korfball is a ball sport **that was invented in the Netherlands in the early 20th century.
 
• It is the only sport specifically designed to be played by participants of both genders simultaneously.
 
• ** Korfball is similar to basketball** and netball in that it is a team sport played on a court with two baskets or goals, but it has some unique rules that make it inclusive for both male and female players.
 
• ** In Korfball, teams consist of four male and four female **players who take turns attacking and defending the baskets.
 
• The sport is played in over 50 countries worldwide and is recognized by the International Olympic Committee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Netball **is a ball sport played between two teams of seven players. It is primarily played by women and is similar to basketball but with some different rules and a different court layout.
 
• **Quidditch **is a fictional sport from the Harry Potter series, which has been adapted for real-life play, primarily by university and college teams. It is played by two teams of seven players, with each player riding a broomstick.
 
• **Basketball** is a ball sport played between two teams of five players. It is a popular sport worldwide and is played at both amateur and professional levels. It is primarily played by men, but there are also women's leagues.
